hypotheses.title: Vitamin D3 Shortens Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Vitamin D3 administration shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound acts as a stressor that accelerates age-related decline in this organism.
hypotheses.rationale: Supraphysiological doses of lipophilic vitamins can overwhelm detoxification pathways and generate oxidative stress. Chronic exposure may thereby accelerate cellular damage and shorten lifespan.
hypotheses.prediction: Vitamin D3-treated worms will show a significantly reduced mean and maximum lifespan compared with untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one group with vitamin D3 and one with vehicle, and perform full lifespan assays with daily scoring under identical conditions.

hypotheses.title: Milnacipran Hydrochloride Extends Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Milnacipran Hydrochloride administration extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound acts to delay age-related decline in this organism.
hypotheses.rationale: Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibition can modulate neural signaling that governs feeding, stress responses, and endocrine pathways. Such modulation is a recognized route to slower aging in short-lived models.
hypotheses.prediction: Milnacipran Hydrochloride-treated worms will show a significantly increased mean and maximum lifespan compared with untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one group with Milnacipran Hydrochloride and one with vehicle, and perform full lifespan assays with daily scoring under identical conditions.

hypotheses.rationale: Vitamin D3 regulates calcium homeostasis, proteostasis, and stress-response gene expression. These conserved functions can improve cellular maintenance and support longer lifespan.

hypotheses.title: Vitamin D3 Extends Lifespan via daf-28-Dependent Signaling
hypotheses.claim: Vitamin D3 administration extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inducing the insulin-like peptide daf-28-dependent pathway. The effect requires intact daf-28 signaling.
hypotheses.rationale: Insulin-like peptides are central regulators of aging, with daf-28 influencing endocrine signaling that controls stress resistance. Vitamin D3-induced modulation of this pathway could reprogram longevity networks.
hypotheses.prediction: Vitamin D3 will extend lifespan in wild-type worms but fail to extend lifespan in daf-28 loss-of-function mutants.
hypotheses.experiment: Perform lifespan assays on wild-type and daf-28 mutant worms treated with vitamin D3 or vehicle, and compare the magnitude of lifespan extension across genotypes.

hypotheses.title: O6-benzylguanine Extends Lifespan via DAF-16 Activation
hypotheses.claim: O6-benzylguanine administration extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting the insulin/IGF-1 signaling pathway through DAF-16 activation. The effect requires DAF-16 activity.
hypotheses.rationale: Reduced insulin/IGF-1 signaling promotes nuclear localization of the FOXO transcription factor DAF-16, which upregulates stress-resistance and longevity genes. A compound that engages this pathway should prolong lifespan.
hypotheses.prediction: O6-benzylguanine will extend lifespan in wild-type worms but fail to extend lifespan in daf-16 loss-of-function mutants.
hypotheses.experiment: Perform lifespan assays on wild-type and daf-16 mutant worms treated with O6-benzylguanine or vehicle, and quantify DAF-16 nuclear localization in a reporter strain.
